cases.title: A black hole renderer from scratch
cases.titleZh: 从零写的黑洞光线追踪
cases.postText:
I asked Claude fable 5.5 for the hardest edit it could make. It wrote a black hole renderer from scratch.

Every pixel is a light ray bent by the real equation for a non-rotating black hole. No game engine, no stock footage, no downloaded textures. Python, 2 CPU cores, about an hour.
